scope: Independent read-only source/receipt review; no tests, browser, runtime build or package build executed by reviewer.

product02.scope: Read-only static integrity; no browser boot, MIME response, art completeness or release certification

presentation02.scope: Client sources, nested source dependencies, public outputs and selected art/content copies are consistent. Top-level installed tools use pinned lockfiles; final reviewed art completeness is a separate receipt gate.

findings.issue: Non-generated runtime input baseline could change between post-runtime check and presentation capture.
findings.resolution: authoredClientSHA256 from that exact capture is compared against pre-runtime clientBefore.

findings.issue: Dynamic Vite entry output could collide with reserved generated paths omitted from copied output set.
findings.resolution: Reserved index.html/art index/base pack/build-assets paths added to dynamic rejection.

findings.issue: Transient added file could survive copy after source path set returned to baseline; host extra JSON likewise.
findings.resolution: Actual product inventory constrained to copied/reserved/Vite output set; native JSON paths equal captured authored set.

remaining_scope_limits: Top-level installed dependency bytes are assumed from pinned npm installation, not fully hashed by this guard.
Input hashes before/after are not an atomic filesystem snapshot or proof against arbitrary source edit-and-restore during compilation.
Actual current-config Vite rehearsal uses existing accepted runtime and incomplete live art; no full make build/runtime/native package execution.
Final reviewed art selection/publication and complete roster/budget/native gameplay acceptance remain separate.
